images.filename: Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing Dynasties 24523-Shenyang (49051738398).jpg
images.caption: The Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing dynasties in Beijing and Shenyang illustrate the grandeur of the imperial institution from the Qing Dynasty to the earlier Ming and Yuan dynasties, and Manchu traditions, and provide evidence on the evolution of this architecture in the 17th and 18th centuries.
images.alt: The Imperial Palaces of the Ming and Qing dynasties in Beijing and Shenyang illustrate the grandeur of the imperial institution from the Qing Dynasty to the earlier Ming and Yuan dynasties, and Manchu traditions, and provide evidence on the evolution of this architecture in the 17th and 18th centuries.

images.caption:
Shenyang is the capital and largest city of China’s northeast Liaoning Province.

Mausoleums of Qing dynasty emperors can be found at Zhaoling Tomb, amid the pine forests and lakes of Beiling Park, and at Fuling Tomb in the city’s east.
